notes.title: The Second Final - BIG UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35320351/06be0284408b23f1e0efcaab6a2564daf4b683f6.jpg[/img]

This update is going to bring very major changes. First of all, graphics, graphics are a priority and one of the basic reason to update the game. The second basic reason is mechanics
The mechanics also had major changes, thanks to Unreal Engine we will get very good results related to the mechanics of the game.
The same changes are for the basic storyline that will provide more changes including the environment
